ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast observed between low-intensity (black) proximal regions and high-intensity (white) distal lobe regions, roughly 65:35 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blob covering the distal 40% of the right lobe with internal black mottling; a smaller high-intensity white patch at the distal tip of the left lobe; central fluke body consists of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel depth of approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations and irregular peaks extracted along the distal trailing edges of both lobes; right lobe shows multiple distinct secondary notches and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge contour follows a deep concave curve from the median notch transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the outer lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, three-dimensional clusters of roughly circular pixel anomalies (barnacle colonization) along the entire trailing edge of the left lobe and the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single, distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruption (dark scratch) traversing the high-intensity white region on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on trailing edge boundaries; possible irregular traumatic indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated high-intensity (white) circular focal point located within the low-intensity (black) field of the right lobe's medial region.
